audience: cleaning and field service teams who manage customers and jobs in ServiceMonster

useCases.title: Review a customer's service history
useCases.text: Find a customer, read the account profile and review related orders and notes. Related lists return one page at a time; request more pages when needed.

useCases.title: Check the service schedule
useCases.text: Look up service routes, read the schedule for a chosen date range and inspect detailed schedule items with their associated job or activity details.

useCases.title: Review orders with balances due
useCases.text: Inspect a page of orders for available totals and balances, then open a selected order for details. Continue through additional pages when reviewing more records.

useCases.title: Add a note to a customer account
useCases.text: Read the selected account, check the exact wording, then create a note immediately. The API User needs note-writing permission; a Read Only role cannot add notes.
